title: A1 Writing Quiz 5 — Exams, Work & Personal Life

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
options: The bus takes school to me.
The bus takes me to school.
Me the bus takes to school.
To school the bus takes me.
questions.explanation: Subject + verb + object + place: 'The bus takes me to school.'

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
questions.explanation: Subject + verb + place: 'My cousin studies in Turkey.'

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
questions.explanation: Subject + verb + object: 'We have a new teacher.'

questions.question: Choose the correct question word order.
questions.explanation: Wh-phrase + auxiliary + subject + verb: 'Which color do you like?'

questions.question: Which sentence uses capital letters correctly?
options: i take the ielts exam in october.
I take the IELTS exam in October.
I Take The ielts exam in october.
i take the IELTS Exam in October.
questions.explanation: Abbreviations (IELTS), month names (October), and 'I' are always capitalized.

questions.question: Choose the correctly capitalized sentence.
questions.explanation: The first word of a sentence and subject names like 'Math' are capitalized.

questions.question: Which sentence has correct punctuation?
questions.explanation: A simple statement ends with a full stop: 'I finish class at 3 pm.'

questions.question: Which sentence has correct punctuation?
questions.explanation: A question ends with a question mark: 'Do you have a pen?'

questions.question: Choose the sentence with correct commas.
options: I bought a pen a notebook and an eraser.
I bought a pen, a notebook and an eraser.
I bought, a pen a notebook, and an eraser.
I bought a pen, a notebook, and, an eraser.
questions.explanation: Use commas to separate items in a list: 'a pen, a notebook and an eraser.'

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: 'They're' is the contraction of 'they are'.

questions.question: My grandmother ___ delicious food.
questions.explanation: Present simple with 'grandmother' (she) takes -s: 'makes'.

questions.question: We ___ our teacher a gift last week.
questions.explanation: 'Last week' signals past simple; irregular past of 'give' is 'gave'.

questions.question: Be careful! The dog ___ at you.
questions.explanation: An action happening right now takes present continuous: 'is barking'.

questions.question: Choose the sentence that correctly uses 'and'.
options: I read books and I watch movies.
I read books and but movies.
questions.explanation: 'And' joins two similar activities: 'I read books and I watch movies.'

questions.question: Choose the sentence that correctly uses 'but'.
options: The exam was easy but I was nervous.
The exam was easy and but nervous.
But the exam was easy nervous.
The exam, nervous but was easy.
questions.explanation: 'But' shows contrast: 'The exam was easy but I was nervous.'

questions.question: Choose the sentence that correctly uses 'because'.
options: I was late because the bus was slow.
Because I was late the bus was slow.
I was late bus was slow because.
Because slow was bus, late I was.
questions.explanation: 'Because' introduces a reason: 'I was late because the bus was slow.'

questions.question: The keys are ___ my bag.
questions.explanation: 'In' is used for something enclosed: 'in my bag.'

questions.question: I usually study ___ the evening.
questions.explanation: 'In' is used with parts of the day: 'in the evening.'

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: He is the a university student.
questions.explanation: 'University' begins with a consonant sound /juː/ → 'a university.'

questions.question: Which is the correct way to start a message to a colleague you know well?
questions.explanation: 'Hi [Name],' is a suitable friendly greeting for a colleague you know well.

questions.question: Which is the correct way to end a casual message to a colleague?
questions.explanation: 'Thanks, [Name]' is a common, friendly closing for casual workplace messages.

questions.question: Which is the correct way to start a formal email applying for a job?
questions.explanation: 'Dear Hiring Manager,' is the standard formal opening for a job application.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly combines 'I speak Azerbaijani.' and 'I speak English.'?
options: I speak Azerbaijani, I speak English.
questions.explanation: Two related abilities can be joined simply: 'I speak Azerbaijani and English.'

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: She has a round beautiful face.
She has a beautiful round face.
She has round a beautiful face.
She has a face round beautiful.
questions.explanation: Opinion adjectives come before shape adjectives: 'a beautiful round face.'

questions.question: Which sentence correctly shows excitement about news?
questions.explanation: An exclamation mark expresses strong excitement: 'I passed my test!'

questions.question: ___ a lot of homework today.
questions.explanation: 'Homework' is uncountable (treated as singular) → 'There is'.

questions.question: This is ___ office. (belongs to the manager)
questions.explanation: Singular possessive: add apostrophe + s → "manager's office".

questions.question: Choose the sentence that correctly uses sequencing words.
options: First, I read the question. Then, I write the answer.
First I read question then write answer then.
Write the answer first then, read I question.
Then first, I read the write answer question.
questions.explanation: Sequencing words like 'First,' and 'Then,' organize steps clearly with commas.

questions.question: The teacher and the students ___ in the classroom.
questions.explanation: Compound subject ('The teacher and the students') is plural → 'are'.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Wh-word + auxiliary + subject + verb: 'When does your class start?'
